text_target: I take the bus to work every morning.
phonetic: /aɪ teɪk ðə bʊs tuː wɜːk ˈɛvri ˈmɔːnɪŋ/
text_native: Je prends le bus pour aller au travail tous les matins.

text_target: Where is the nearest subway station?
phonetic: /wɛər ɪz ðə ˈnɪərɪst ˈsʌbweɪ ˈsteɪʃən/
text_native: Où se trouve la station de métro la plus proche ?

text_target: How much is a ticket to the city center?
phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ə ˈtɪkɪt tuː ðə ˈsɪti ˈsɛntər/
text_native: C'est combien un billet pour le centre-ville ?

text_target: You need to change trains at the next stop.
phonetic: /juː niːd tuː tʃeɪndʒ treɪnz æt ðə nɛkst stɒp/
text_native: Tu dois changer de train au prochain arrêt.

text_target: My train was delayed by twenty minutes.
phonetic: /maɪ treɪn wɒz dɪˈleɪd baɪ ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts/
text_native: Mon train a eu vingt minutes de retard.

text_target: Excuse me, does this bus go to the beach?
phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz miː, dʌz ðɪs bʊs gəʊ tuː ðə biːtʃ/
text_native: Excusez-moi, est-ce que ce bus va à la plage ?

text_target: It is faster to go there by bicycle.
phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈfɑːstər tuː gəʊ ðɛər baɪ ˈbaɪsɪkl/
text_native: C'est plus rapide d'y aller en vélo.

text_target: Let us walk, it is only a ten-minute stroll.
phonetic: /lɛt ʌs wɔːk, ɪt ɪz ˈəʊnli ə tɛn ˈmɪnɪt strəʊl/
text_native: Marchons, c'est à dix minutes à pied seulement.

text_target: Traffic is really heavy during rush hour.
phonetic: /ˈtræfɪk ɪz ˈriːəli ˈhɛvi ˈdjʊərɪŋ rʌʃ ˈaʊər/
text_native: Il y a vraiment beaucoup de circulation aux heures de pointe.

text_target: Can you call a cab for me, please?
phonetic: /kæn juː kɔːl ə kæb fɔː miː, pliːz/
text_native: Tu peux m'appeler un taxi s'il te plaît ?

text_target: I always miss my morning connection.
phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz mɪs maɪ ˈmɔːnɪŋ kəˈnɛkʃən/
text_native: Je rate toujours ma correspondance du matin.

text_target: Do I need to validate my ticket before getting on?
phonetic: /duː aɪ niːd tuː ˈvælɪdeɪt maɪ ˈtɪkɪt bɪˈfɔːr ˈgɛtɪŋ ɒn/
text_native: Est-ce que je dois composter mon ticket avant de monter ?

text_target: She prefers driving because she hates public transport.
phonetic: /ʃiː prɪˈfɜːz ˈdraɪvɪŋ bɪˈkɒz ʃiː heɪts ˈpʌblɪk ˈtrænspɔːt/
text_native: Elle préfère conduire parce qu'elle déteste les transports en commun.

text_target: Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight.
phonetic: /tɜːn lɛft æt ðə ˈtræfɪk laɪts, ðɛn gəʊ streɪt/
text_native: Tourne à gauche au feu tricolore, puis va tout droit.

text_target: Parking spaces are impossible to find around here.
phonetic: /ˈpɑːkɪŋ speɪsɪz ɑːr ɪmˈpɒsɪbl tuː faɪnd əˈraʊnd hɪər/
text_native: C'est impossible de trouver une place pour se garer par ici.

text_target: Which platform does the London train leave from?
phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈplætfɔːm dʌz ðə ˈlʌndən treɪn liːv frɒm/
text_native: De quel quai part le train pour Londres ?

text_target: We got lost because the street signs were unclear.
phonetic: /wiː gɒt lɒst bɪˈkɒz ðə striːt saɪnz wɜːr ʌnˈklɪər/
text_native: On s'est perdus parce que les panneaux de rue n'étaient pas clairs.

text_target: I usually book my flights online a month early.
phonetic: /aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli bʊk maɪ flaɪts ˈɒnˌlaɪn ə mʌnθ ˈɜːli/
text_native: D'habitude, je réserve mes billets d'avion en ligne un mois à l'avance.

text_target: Remember to fasten your seatbelt before we start driving.
phonetic: /rɪˈmɛmbər tuː ˈfɑːsən jɔːr ˈsiːtbɛlt bɪˈfɔːr wiː stɑːt ˈdraɪvɪŋ/
text_native: N'oublie pas de mettre ta ceinture de sécurité avant qu'on ne parte.

text_target: How long does the ferry ride to the island take?
phonetic: /haʊ lɒŋ dʌz ðə ˈfɛri raɪd tuː ðə ˈaɪlənd teɪk/
text_native: Combien de temps dure la traversée en ferry jusqu'à l'île ?
